texts.preamble: Amra Ram Bhati vs . State Of Rajasthan & Ors. on 17 April, 2015 Author: Sangeet Lodha Bench: Sangeet Lodha Amra Ram Bhati Vs. State Of Rajasthan & Ors. (S.B.Civil Writ Petition No.3459/08) 1
texts.facts: 1. This writ petition is directed against notice dated 15.5.08 issued by the Deputy Secretary, Local Self Department, Government of Rajasthan, initiating proceedings under Section 63 of Rajasthan Municipalities Act, 1959 ( for short "the Act") for removal of the petitioner as member of Municipal Board, Pipar City. 2. The proceedings for removal has been initiated on the ground that the cognizance for offences under Sections 7(i) (ii) (vi)/16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 ( 'PFA Act') having been taken by the court of competent jurisdiction, on a complaint lodged against the petitioner, he has incurred disqualification under Section 26(i)(c) of the Act.
texts.arguments: 3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that as per provisions of Section 26(i)(c) of the Act, a person incurs disqualification for being chosen as or for being a member of the Municipal Board, who has been convicted for offence under the AMRA RAM BHATI VS. STATE OF RAJASTHAN & ORS. (S.B.CIVIL WRIT PETITION NO.3459/08) PFA Act and therefore, merely, on account of cognizance being taken for offences under the PFA Act, no proceedings could have been initiated against the petitioner for his removal as member of the Municipal Board. Amra Ram Bhati vs . State Of Rajasthan & Ors. Learned Additional Government Counsel submits that the tenure of the petitioner as member has already come to an end and therefore, even otherwise, the question of continuing with the proceedings for removal does not arise. 6. Indisputably, as per the provisions of Section 63 (1)(c) of the Act, member of a Municipal Board is liable to be removed on the ground that after his election, he has incurred any of the disqualification mentioned in Section 18 or Section 26 or has ceased to fulfill the requirement of Section 24. 7. Section 26 which deals with the general disqualification for members and as per clause (i-c) thereof, a person notwithstanding that he is otherwise qualified shall be disqualified for being chosen as of or for being as member of the Board who has been convicted of an offence under PFA Act. 8.
